Name: Riddles in the Dark
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[center][b][u][size=5]Riddles in the Dark[/size][/u][/b][/center]
[size=4]
There are places in the valley people do not to visit.

Hidden beneath an old passage near Pelican Town is a strange cave containing a well that does not appear in any town record. Nobody knows who built it. Nobody knows where its water comes from.

And, according to the stories, sometimes it talks.

Riddles in the Dark adds a mysterious cursed well to Stardew Valley, offering the player a daily bargain: a little blood in exchange for the chance to solve a riddle and receive rewards.

The well is not especially concerned with whether you succeed.

In fact, it may prefer when you don't.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]Features[/u][/b][/size][size=4]

A new hidden cave and cursed well that offers one riddle per day....for a price.[/size]

[size=4]120 unique riddles[/size]

[size=4]1 event with Willy. Don't say he didn't try to warn you. [/size]

[size=4]Villager reactions about your interactions with the spirit that dwells inside the well.[/size]

[size=4]A separate story line if you wish to pay for it in blood. [/size]

[size=5][u][b]The Well Remembers You[/b][/u][/size]

[size=4]The spirit inside the well is more than a vending machine with a quasi-evil disposition.

Your interactions with it gradually change over time.

The mod tracks your history with the well, including your bargains and performance. As you continue returning, its dialogue evolves.

At certain milestones, the well begins treating you less like a stranger and more like an increasingly familiar source of entertainment.

It may also reveal fragments of its history...for a price. Pay the blood cost and decline his riddles to get to know the thing in the well. Maybe they'll even tell you their name if you keep asking. 

Whether any of them are true is another question entirely.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]Lots of Randomized Dialogue[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Repeated visits will not feel repetitive.

The well has a large randomized dialogue pool for:

Greeting the player before the bargain
Reacting after receiving blood
Mocking incorrect answers
Different stages of the player's relationship with the well

Its personality is theatrical, maniacal, unsettling, occasionally funny, and entirely too pleased with itself. It finds joy in your failures. [/size]

[size=5][u][b]Lilacor: The Talking Sword Crossover[/b][/u][/size]

[size=4]If you also have my mod Lilacor: The Talking Sword installed, the well gains additional crossover dialogue.

Apparently, Lilacor and whatever lives beneath the well have known each other for quite some time.

Neither has anything particularly kind to say about the other.

The two trade insults indirectly through the player, reference old arguments, accuse each other of cheating, and occasionally hint at a much longer history than either is willing to explain.

Lilacor is not required to use Riddles in the Dark. The crossover dialogue simply activates automatically if the mod is installed.[/size]

[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45086]Download it here[/url][/size]

[size=5][u][b]Blood Price[/b][/u][/size]

[size=4]The default cost of accepting a riddle is 25 Health. This can be changed in the mod configuration.

Available blood-cost settings include:

10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 / 40 / 50 Health

The well will refuse the bargain if paying would make your character pass out.

It also requires enough free inventory space to safely deliver a reward.[/size]

[size=5][u][b]Configuration[/b][/u][/size]

[size=4]The mod includes configurable options for:[/size]

[size=4]Blood cost & difficulty[/size]

[size=5][u][b]A Note About the Riddles[/b][/u][/size][size=4]

The riddle pool includes a mixture of original writing, adapted traditional riddles, and riddles inspired by the long tradition of oral and written word puzzles.

The goal is not to reproduce the riddles from The Hobbit, but to capture that same feeling:

You are alone underground. Something strange is talking to you. And it wants to know how clever you really are.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]Reporting Problems[/u][/b][/size][size=4]

If something does not work correctly, please include your SMAPI log when reporting the issue.

A SMAPI log makes troubleshooting significantly easier.[/size]

[size=5][u][b]F.A.Q.[/b][/u][/size]
[size=4]Q: Can I translate this mod?[/size]
[size=4]A: Absolutely. [/size]

[size=4]Q: Does this mod use AI?[/size]
[size=4]A: No. I made the map and the well sprite myself. No AI was used to code or write this. [/size]

[size=4]Q: You know what would be cool?[/size]
[size=4]A: Tell me and maybe I can add it to the game. [/size]
